glosses: A word or phrase whose only function is to make a sentence metrically balanced.

examples.text: The genius of prose rejects the cheville no less emphatically than the laws of verse; and the cheville, I should perhaps explain to some of my readers, is any meaningless or very watered phrase employed to strike a balance in the sound.
